checks.static_amplitude_crosstalk_hamiltonian: PASS: one fixed gamma and chi solves both physical phase constraints. No freely assigned arm PMFs.
checks.exact_full_output_laws: PASS: reconstructed by independent Fraction readout convolution; old/new-good Delta=-1/100, old/new-null Delta=0.
checks.all_four_allowed_actions: PASS: old spectator_plus and both spectator_0 actions coincide across worlds. Only new spectator_plus carries KL.
checks.adaptive_action_KL_chain: PASS: algorithm randomization and predictable action probabilities are common conditional on the same history; actions add no extra KL. Outcome KL sums to E_good[N_new_target]*D. At finite cap this is immediate; finite expected stopping also follows from bounded per-step log likelihoods. Infinite expected total cost already satisfies the lower bound.
checks.decision_data_processing: PASS: P_good(accept)>=.95 and P_null(accept)<=.01 imply KL>=kl(.95,.01); uniform validity over the enlarged family includes the exact-null witness.
checks.sign_test_risk: PASS: E[factor_plus]=1+.5*(x_old-x_new), so it is a supermartingale on x_old<=x_new. The opposite process is analogous. Each wrong direction has risk<=1/200; at equality their union is<=1/100.
checks.bounded_stopped_Wald: PASS: let T be the first positive crossing and S_n=log Lplus. For every n, E[S_(T wedge n)]=drift*E[T wedge n], while pathwise S_(T wedge n)<=log200+log1.5. Monotone convergence proves E[T]<infinity and the stated bound without presupposing Wald integrability.
checks.finite_cap_power: PASS: P(correct accept)>=1-P(ever wrong crossing)-P(T>65536)>=1-1/200-E[T]/65536. Stopping at the first crossing or the cap reduces actual expected shots.
checks.X_only_failure_at_null: PASS: both worlds have identical old/new X laws, hence identical X-only stopped transcripts and acceptance probabilities.
checks.cross_model_ratio: PASS: uniform enlarged-class cost is bounded below; a valid promised-common-Q control is bounded above. Their quotient is a cross-model cost separation, not same-information same-model SOTA superiority.
checks.independent_high_precision_numerics: PASS: 150-digit mpmath checks all reported one-sided numerical bounds, independently of the target script execution.

scope_clarifications: The theorem uses exact inverse-trigonometric controls and coefficients. Displayed floating angles and binary64 gate comparisons only check numerical consistency; they do not define the exact laws behind 64-digit KL enclosures.
The common-Q sign guarantee requires s=Q(00)>0. It does not extend to arbitrary common Q with s=0, where target Delta=0 regardless of the X difference.
Extra amplitudes, durations, nonlisted preparations, side-channel data or prior exclusion of the null coefficients can invalidate this particular lower-bound experiment.
The explicit common-Q control is not claimed minimax optimal. Its feasible upper bound suffices for the cross-model separation.
